description: Stamp a text or logo mark on a batch of images, like the site’s Watermark: a tiled diagonal pattern (the default) or a single mark in one of nine positions. Text can be anything, e.g. “© Your Studio 2026”, “Draft”, “Confidential” or “Proof”. Size is a share of each image’s shorter side. Saved next to the originals as name-marked.ext (or into output_dir); originals are never changed.

angle.description: Tiled pattern rotation in degrees; negative rises to the right.

files.description: Image files or folders (a folder means the images in it). ~ is your home folder.

font.description: Typeface for a text mark: serif (Instrument Serif), sans (Inter) or mono (JetBrains Mono), falling back to the computer’s own fonts.

format.description: Output format. "original" keeps each file’s own (HEIC, AVIF and TIFF become JPEG, GIF becomes PNG).

logo.description: A logo file to use as the mark instead of text (a transparent PNG or an SVG works best).

margin.description: Gap from the edge for a single mark, as a % of the shorter side.

output_dir.description: Folder to save results in. Default: next to each original. Originals are never overwritten.

position.description: Where the mark goes: one of the nine positions for a single mark, or "tiled" for a repeated diagonal pattern over the whole image.

quality.description: Quality for JPEG and WebP (30 to 100).

shadow.description: A soft shadow under the mark, so it reads on light and dark areas.

size.description: Mark size as a % of the image’s shorter side (2 to 40). For a logo this sets its longer side (×1.6).

spacing.description: Gap between tiled marks, as a % of the default gap.

text.description: The mark’s text, e.g. “© Your Studio 2026”. Default “© One Design”. Ignored when a logo is given.
